name: AD Chase V5 - Job Prospecting Pipeline

parameters.content:
## 1 · Triggers & region config
Webhook (scheduled run) or manual run. Picks the search URLs of the region; Monday uses 3-day windows.

## 2 · Parallel scraping
One HTTP call per job board to the Playwright backend.

## 3 · Merge & pre-filter
One offer per company (best salary); keyword filters cut LLM calls.

## 4 · AI screening
DeepSeek returns KEEP / IGNORE as strict JSON.

## 5 · Client check & monthly dedupe
Skip existing clients (optional) and companies already kept this month.

## 6 · PDF export & report
Batch export of kept offers as PDFs, then run report.
